{name}, the LORD who created and redeemed His people calls His own by name. In Christ you belong to Him — so take courage in His redeeming love and do not fear.
{name}, the same God who promised Israel His presence, strength and help is your God in Christ. You need not fear or be dismayed, for He upholds His own.
{name}, in Christ you are God's workmanship, created for the good works He prepared beforehand for you to walk in.
{name}, Jesus Christ is the resurrection and the life. Because you believe in Him, you have the hope of life that outlasts death.
{name}, may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace as you trust in Him, that you may abound in hope through the power of the Holy Spirit.

{name}, receive the same affection the apostle John had for his friend Gaius: a heartfelt prayer that your life would go well and your body be strong, flourishing in step with a soul that is thriving in Christ.
{name}, receive the call of wisdom to honour the godly instruction you have been given, and let it shape the way you live.
{name}, hold fast to the fear of the LORD, for there is a sure future, and the hope of those who walk with Him will not be cut off.
{name}, do not forget the teaching of wisdom; let your heart keep its commands, for they are life and peace.
{name}, the good purposes God declared over the exiles reveal His heart; in Christ you too can trust Him with your future and your hope.
{name}, you can rest in this: God works all things together for good to those who love Him and are called according to His purpose.
{name}, in all these things you are more than a conqueror through Him who loved you.
{name}, you can trust the God who promised to supply His people's every need according to His riches in glory by Christ Jesus.
{name}, in Christ who strengthens you, you can face whatever He calls you to, in plenty and in want.
{name}, you can say with David: the LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
{name}, even in the darkest valley you need fear no evil, for the Shepherd is with you.
{name}, take the courage God gave Joshua: be strong, do not be afraid, for the LORD your God is with you wherever you go.
{name}, as you wait on the LORD, He renews your strength; you can run and not be weary, walk and not faint.
{name}, hear the invitation of Jesus to come to Him when you are weary and burdened, and to receive His rest.
{name}, seek first God's kingdom and righteousness, and trust Him to provide what you need.
{name}, receive the peace Jesus gives His disciples — not as the world gives; let not your heart be troubled or afraid.
{name}, the love God showed the world He shows to you: He gave His only Son, that believing in Him you should not perish but have everlasting life.
{name}, if you are in Christ you are a new creation; the old has passed, the new has come.
{name}, cast all your care upon Him, for He cares for you.
{name}, God is your refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
{name}, the LORD's mercies never fail; His compassions are new every morning — great is His faithfulness.
{name}, His compassions are new every morning; great is His faithfulness toward you.
{name}, the LORD your God is in your midst, mighty to save; He delights over His people with joy.
{name}, be content, for God has said He will never leave you nor forsake you.
{name}, if you confess your sins, He is faithful and just to forgive you and to cleanse you from all unrighteousness.
{name}, the one whose mind is stayed on the LORD He keeps in perfect peace, because they trust in Him.
{name}, be strong and of good courage; the LORD your God goes with you — He will not fail you nor forsake you.
{name}, the LORD is near to the broken-hearted and saves the crushed in spirit.
{name}, God has not given you a spirit of fear, but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
{name}, be assured that nothing in all creation can separate you from the love of God in Christ Jesus.
{name}, you have been crucified with Christ; the life you now live, you live by faith in the Son of God who loved you and gave Himself for you.
{name}, in Christ you are called to be light in the world; let your light so shine that others may glorify your Father.
{name}, no temptation has overtaken you but such as is common to all; God is faithful and will make a way of escape.
{name}, come boldly to the throne of grace, that you may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need.
{name}, the LORD will preserve you from all evil; He will keep your life.
{name}, the LORD is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble, and He knows those who take refuge in Him.
{name}, the LORD holds your right hand and says to His own, Fear not; I will help you.
{name}, dwelling in the shelter of the Most High, you abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
{name}, in the world you will have trouble, but take heart — Jesus has overcome the world.
{name}, this is the heritage of the servants of the LORD: no weapon formed against them shall prosper — your vindication is from Him.
{name}, in Christ you belong to a chosen generation, a royal priesthood, a people for God's own possession, called out of darkness into His light.
{name}, He is able to keep you from falling and to present you faultless before His glory with great joy.
{name}, the LORD is your light and your salvation; whom shall you fear?
{name}, be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and thanksgiving make your requests known to God.
{name}, may the peace of God, which passes all understanding, guard your heart and mind through Christ Jesus.
